request_routing: All starts and observer reads use one declared ingress engine. Job execution may occur on any registered engine.
primary_clock: One generator monotonic clock, scheduled arrival through the last response needed to verify the original process, final variables and three independently committed receipts.
arrival_policy: Fixed absolute schedule. No queued catch-up, no mutation retries. Record a missed arrival if dispatch is late or all workers are occupied. Keep every scheduled arrival in the denominator.
scope: Small normal-case driver and timing qualification only. No warmup, resource-headroom, capacity, scale-out or performance-comparison claim. This is not the measured campaign protocol.
